variants.name: absolute_12k
variants.expected_effect: Test remaining learning capacity without changing parameterization; median/bias may improve but constant-LR oscillation may persist.

variants.name: anchored_3k
variants.expected_effect: Preserve precise candidate locations; 3 anchored and 1 free means maintain candidate-outlier/gap hypotheses. Tails and sharpness may trade off.

variants.name: anchored_12k
variants.expected_effect: Compare with absolute_12k at same steps and anchored_3k at same architecture; test whether anchoring gains persist with more learning.
